tweets.text:
As the year comes to a close, we still have the most secure border of my lifetime thanks to the unwavering leadership of President Trump and his dedication to making America safe and prosperous. Recently, I was able to travel with CBP Commissioner Rodney Scott to several sites along the SW Border to thank those on the frontlines who made this achievement happen and continue to work tirelessly every day to protect our country and ensure the border is secure. A secure border saves lives and a secure border strengthens our national security. @CBP
@CBPCommissioner @WhiteHouse

author.description: Border Czar for President Donald J. Trump

tweets.text:
At TPUSA’s AmericaFest conference this weekend 
it was my pleasure to stop by the DHS booth area to greet some of the fine men and women of DHS who were recruiting patriots for critical law enforcement missions. 

I also had the opportunity to address the TPUSA crowd and give them the facts about this Administration’s border security and immigration enforcement efforts, as well as our unprecedented accomplishments just within this first year. 

—We have the most secure border in our Nation’s history. No one is being released. Border crossings are down 95% from the Biden Administration. 

—More than 2.5 million illegal aliens have been removed or self-deported from our country. And, with criminal aliens being the majority of arrests this year, President Trump remains focused on making our communities safe.

—More than 129,000 children that were smuggled as unaccompanied alien children across Biden’s open border—that the last Administration released to unvetted sponsors, lost track of, and weren’t looking for—have been located. 

We are just getting started! America is a nation of laws, and President Trump is committed to strong national security, public safety and saving lives, a prosperous economy for all here legally, and upholding the integrity of our immigration laws passed by Congress.  

God bless President Trump for his vision and leadership. God bless the men and women, and their families, who defend our homeland executing critical border security and immigration enforcement missions. They made the success achieved this year happen. 

Promises made, promises kept. @whitehouse
